status: NO-GO: OPERATIONAL TRACK GATE NOT PASSED

protocol.training: expanding real 2025 days strictly before each evaluation month

cycles.name: robust_residual_rule
cycles.mechanism: Carry last same-weekday pressure forward and adjust for recent robust level shift/persistence.
cycles.falsification: Fails paired 15% PR-AUC gate or temporal/workload guardrails.

cycles.name: logistic_calendar
cycles.falsification: Calendar-only ranking does not beat seasonal baseline.

cycles.name: logistic_calendar_lags
cycles.mechanism: Add autoregressive level signals to the transparent calendar model.
cycles.falsification: Lag-family ablation has non-positive paired gain over calendar-only.

cycles.name: logistic_full
cycles.mechanism: Linear combination of calendar, lag, rolling, residual, and regime evidence.
cycles.falsification: Full features do not improve over calendar+lags or are temporally unstable.

cycles.name: isolation_regime_hybrid
cycles.mechanism: Use Isolation Forest to amplify only high-side context anomalies on top of the robust rule.
cycles.falsification: Unsupervised novelty adds no paired outcome association or destabilizes folds.

cycles.name: extra_trees_no_rolling
cycles.mechanism: Capture nonlinear interactions without rolling-distribution features.
cycles.falsification: Does not beat linear/full and baseline gates.
cycles.ablation: Tree model with rolling-distribution family removed.

cycles.name: extra_trees_full
cycles.mechanism: Capture nonlinear interactions across all point-in-time feature families.
cycles.falsification: Rolling family is non-incremental or candidate fails temporal gates.

cycles.name: hist_gradient_boosting
cycles.mechanism: Sequentially fit nonlinear residual structure with bounded shallow leaves.
cycles.falsification: No paired improvement or excessive fold/seed sensitivity.
cycles.ablation: Boosting inductive bias on the same full feature matrix as cycle 7.

cycles.name: hybrid_rank_blend
cycles.mechanism: Equal within-fold rank average of Extra Trees, full logistic, and fixed robust rule; weights are fixed, not fit on evaluation data.
cycles.falsification: Fails any paired, monthly, half-year, or workload gate.
cycles.ablation: Ensemble versus strongest constituent on identical folds.

synthetic.reason: The available synthetic daily series was generated from 2025 observations, including the July-December evaluation period, and represents the P2/P3 KPI subset rather than all-incident workload. Using it would mismatch the target and risk future-information leakage.
synthetic.evidence_separation: All metrics in this track use real raw opening timestamps only.

lag_levels.mechanism: Recent and seasonal observed workload persistence.
lag_levels.leakage: Positive shifts only; target-day count excluded.
lag_levels.missing: Median imputation fitted in each training fold.

rolling_distribution.mechanism: Robust recent workload level, dispersion, and weekday capacity proxy.
rolling_distribution.leakage: Every rolling input shifted by one; same-weekday windows shift one group observation.
rolling_distribution.missing: Minimum histories enforced; fold-fitted median imputation.
rolling_distribution.compute: O(n*w), under 1 MB for this series.

seasonal_residual.mechanism: Recent deviations from the point-in-time same-weekday capacity proxy.
seasonal_residual.leakage: Current-day residual is shifted before use.
seasonal_residual.missing: Fold-fitted median imputation or zero in fixed rule.

trend_regime.mechanism: Detect persistent level shift/change relative to longer context.
trend_regime.leakage: No centered windows or future change points.
